'''Ben Atkins''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 2000 Huntsville tournament (30 December)]] on 30 December 2000 with [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|Quiet Mining Colony with Docking Bays and Ben Kenobi]], according to Andy McClure's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1587">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-03-huntsville-al-12-30-00d1587/ huntsville-al-12-30-00], DeckTech (Andy "Solo337" McClure, 3 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-03-huntsville-al-12-30-00d1587/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
